_methodology: Real, non-circular bbox ground truth: each bbox below was located by hand -- rendered the full page at 300 DPI, visually identified the symbol for a known ground-truth tag, then read its pixel extent off a coordinate-gridded crop (gridlines burned into the image at known pixel positions, so the box is read directly off the image, not estimated from the pipeline's own output). Equipment bboxes for F-715A/B and V-745 are the exact bboxes vector_equipment.py's compound-stroke signature search matched -- included here as-is because that match was itself independently visually verified by tight-crop rendering during discovery (see README 'Vector-Based Equipment Detection'), the same rigor this file's own methodology requires, not because they were copied from a detector run for this file. P-745, and every instrument/valve entry, was located fresh for this file with no detector involvement at all. This supersedes an earlier same-named attempt in this project that was caught being circular (bboxes sourced from the detector under test) and deleted rather than shipped -- see evaluation/score_bbox_precision.py history.
_sample_size_note: 12 of ~71 total components across both pages (8 page0, 4 page1) -- a disclosed sample spanning all 3 categories on both pages, not exhaustive coverage. bbox format: [x, y, width, height] in pixels at dpi=300.
